# Joint Clinic Kanpur — Centre of Arthroplasty & Arthroscopy

## Organization Overview
Joint Clinic is Kanpur's premier centre for advanced joint replacement (Arthroplasty), sports injury keyhole surgery (Arthroscopy), and regenerative joint preservation (PRP therapy). Directed by Dr. Gaurav Bhargava, a Delhi-trained joint replacement specialist with 20+ years of clinical experience and over 10,000 satisfied patients treated across Northern India.

## Clinical Facilities & Timings

### 1. Joint Clinic — Swaroop Nagar (Evening Specialist OPD)
- Address: 7/198-A 4, Anand Bazar, Khalasi Lines, Swaroop Nagar, Kanpur, Uttar Pradesh 208002
- Timings: Monday to Saturday, 04:00 PM – 07:00 PM
- Focus: Specialist joint consultations, second opinions, digital X-rays, PRP therapy, and pre/post-operative evaluation.
- Phone: +91 73090 38872

### 2. Bhargava Medical & Trauma Centre (BMTC) — Kidwai Nagar (Day OPD & Surgical Hospital)

- Phone: +91 73090 38872

## Lead Surgeon Profile
- Name: Dr. Gaurav Bhargava
- Qualifications: MBBS, MS (Orthopaedics)
- Senior Residency: Maulana Azad Medical College (MAMC) & Lok Nayak Jai Prakash (LNJP) Hospital, New Delhi
- Professional Memberships: Indian Orthopaedic Association (IOA), UP Orthopaedic Association (UPOA)
- Experience: 20+ Years of Orthopaedic & Joint Reconstruction Excellence

## Core Specialties & Procedures
- Total Knee Replacement (TKR): Subvastus muscle-sparing technique, high-flexion implants, rapid recovery walking protocol within 24 hours.
- Total Hip Replacement (THR): Uncemented ceramic-on-polyethylene and dual-mobility bearings for Avascular Necrosis (AVN) and advanced arthritis.
- Knee Arthroscopy: Keyhole minimally invasive surgery for ACL ligament reconstruction and Meniscus repairs.
- Joint Preservation & PRP: Platelet-Rich Plasma therapy and viscosupplementation for Grade 1-2 knee osteoarthritis.
- Spine & Sciatica Care: Lumbar disc decompression, sciatica pain management, and non-surgical postural rehabilitation.
- Complex Trauma & Fracture Care: 24/7 emergency polytrauma stabilization, intra-articular fracture reconstruction at BMTC.
